So invalid inputs:
"256.1.1.1"
"192.168.1"
are being accepted as valid, hence HTTP 204 response is generated instead of rejection.

=== Test 28: Invalid IPv4 - Out of range ===
NTP Server: 256.1.1.1
Expected: FAIL
HTTP Status: 204
Current NTP Config:
{
  "NTPServers": [
    "256.1.1.1"
  ],
  "NetworkSuppliedServers": [],
  "ProtocolEnabled": true
}
✗ FAILED - Expected rejection but got HTTP 204
Response: 
{
  "NTPServers": [
    "256.1.1.1"
  ],
  "NetworkSuppliedServers": [],
  "ProtocolEnabled": true
}
